text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This happened when I visited the studio—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next up is... Show us a cool 
pose, please!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Understood. ...Hah—!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ooh. Crisp and totally picture-perfect.
choice_data_list: Um, what are you girls up to...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. Actually, I was studying the 
fundamentals of fan service.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The three of us have a joint live coming 
up soon. We're eager to capture the fans' 
hearts all over again, so we're practicing 
hard~♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, it is nearly time. May we move on 
to the next task, both of you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed their fan service practice was 
set to continue. Thinking I might learn 
something useful for my trainee's lives, I 
decided to observe.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So this short video is what is currently 
trending... I must study it thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. Blowing a kiss right after that 
serious expression... Exquisite technique.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A sudden shift in pacing from a cool 
impression to a cute appeal... I see, so 
this is why it went viral.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My research into approaches that 
resonate with the hearts of fans remains 
insufficient. This is an area with 
significant room for growth.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Now then, ladies. I am counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~, Ikuno-san♪ You're shining today 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ready, set, Ikuno-san. Make a heart pose~, 
if you please.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Right. Gazing straight into the fan's 
eyes—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Curren & Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wahh♪ That was the best~! Ooh~...! That 
made my heart skip, yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation. Thanks to 
you, I believe I am steadily leveling up.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the two of you, my awareness 
of scanning the audience was lacking. With 
this, I should be able to respond to the 
fans' voices as well.
choice_data_list:
You really analyze yourself thoroughly, 
don't you?

You really do a thorough self-analysis, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Knowing oneself is the very first step 
toward growth, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Managing what is lacking and what needs 
improvement. That is how one gets closer 
to achieving results.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I am very impressed. Ikuno-san is truly 
dependable, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Cuteness isn't built in a day, after all! 
All that accumulation will lead to the 
ultimate cuteness♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. ...Because I believe in it 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Grasping one's abilities and managing them 
appropriately. By doing so, any goal can 
be attained.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That is what management is all about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Later on, rumors reached my ears that 
Ikuno Dictus and the others' live was a 
massive hit with the fans.
